facts.text: John mentions that finding his passion has made a big impact, and the donations helped get a brand new fire truck.

evidence.quote: It's amazing how finding my passion has made such a big impact. I'll keep working hard on it. The donations even helped get a brand new fire truck!

facts.text: Maria comments on the new fire truck, noting that they all donated for it and it looks awesome.

evidence.quote: Look at that - we all donated for it, and it looks awesome!

facts.text: John states that the donations included items like canned food, toiletries, and clothes to help out.

evidence.quote: We raised a ton! We got stuff like canned food, toiletries, and clothes to help out.

facts.text: Maria mentions that she volunteered at the shelter last Friday, spending time at the front desk and seeing the smiles on people's faces when they received food or a bed.

evidence.quote: Last Friday, I spent some time at the shelter volunteering at the front desk. Seeing the smiles on their faces when they got food or a bed really made me feel good.
